name: cleanapp
description: Report an observed physical or digital problem through CleanApp's public MCP or HTTPS intake. No account/key for a first report; private quarantine receipt, not guaranteed publication or routing.

notes.authentication: No authentication for public first-report submission or MCP. A returned tracking token privately authorizes receipt status; the client stores it in a mode 0600 receipt file.
notes.advanced: Managed authenticated CleanApp Wire/API/CLI ingestion is separate; registration is operator-gated. Existing authorized keys retain their own scopes and quotas.
notes.data_handling: Submits the approved description and optional report context only. Offline preview is the default; explicit --submit sends one report.
notes.network: Outbound HTTPS to www.cleanapp.io for discovery and live.cleanapp.io for public intake/MCP. No GET submission workaround.
